description.value: Major League 2 Taphouse and Sports Pub is a family-owned casual dining spot in Chilliwack offering an extensive selection of domestic, imported, and local craft beers. The spacious dog-friendly patio — complete with what the owners describe as dinosaurs — provides a welcoming stop for anyone rolling through the Fraser Valley. A Saturday/Sunday/holiday brunch and a broad food menu round out the experience for hungry cyclists.

address.value: 45768 Gaetz St., Chilliwack, British Columbia V2R4E5
